title: 第十四章 黎雾测试失败了
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“陆队，就是这个房间。”

“我们已经按照要求准备好了。”

云城监狱内部。

张警官走在最前方，带领着陆云铮和黎雾朝一个大型办公室走去。

随着办公室房门

黎雾下意识抬头朝他们脑袋上看去。

她在看他们，而此时房间里的众位“好人”也正在看着黎雾。

“这么年轻的小姑娘，出现在这里干什么？”

“不知道，估计是什么大人物的游戏吧。”

“你说她认得出来吗？要是一个罪犯都找不出来，那今天才是丢脸丢大了。”

一看就很年轻的小姑娘，在出现的瞬间，就让这群等待着测试的人满脸奇怪的挠了挠头。

倒是记得张警官提前交代好的话，要演好一个好人。

一个接一个，皆是面带笑容的看着黎雾。

只是那笑容之中，细看之下，同样几分鄙夷。

没有人觉得黎雾一个年轻轻轻的小姑娘，真的能成功把他们这群演技好的罪犯从人群里找出来。

黎雾显然也意识到了这古怪的友善笑容，并不放在心上，只抬眸目光朝这群人脑袋上看去。

看着那一个接一个的格外标红加粗放大的红色词条，唇角无声的勾了勾。

“开始吧。”

陆云铮冷硬的声音响起，打破空气中的寂静。

朝人群抬了抬下巴，示意让黎雾开始分辨。

办公室角落的监控冒着红光，一丝不苟的把发生在现场的画面传递到神秘办公室的众位领导面前。

办公室里

几个领导坐在一起，目光灼灼的看着这一幕。

有人低声道：“她要开始了。”

只见画面之中，黎雾开始抬腿朝人群走去。

特意精挑细选出来，表面上看起来完全是好人模样的罪犯们，时刻谨记着张警官说的话，要好好演戏，演好一个好人。

脸上朝黎雾露出一个再和善不过的笑容。

落在黎雾眼里的，却是他们头顶上，那一颗接一个，标红加粗，显眼直接的词条。

【入室偷窃凶手】，【冲动杀人凶手】，【家暴老婆凶手】，【行贿凶手】……

一个接一个的标签映入眼帘。

黎雾没有犹豫，抬手在众人面前快速点过：

“你，你，你，你，还有你，全部出列。”

众人配合出列。

黎雾扭头朝陆云铮看去，“就是他们。”

“他们都是凶手。”

全程不过一分钟，就把张警官精心安排的8个面容善良的好人罪犯给挨个点了出来。

被点出来的罪犯们脸上笑容一僵。

Page (1/3)

"Army, this is the room."

"We are ready as required."

Inside Yuncheng Prison.

Officer Zhang walked at the front, leading Lu Yunzheng and Li Wu towards a large office.

With the office door

Li Wu subconsciously raised his head and looked at their heads.

She was looking at them, and at this time all the "good people" in the room were also looking at Li Wu.

"What is such a young girl doing here?"

"I don't know, it's probably some big shot's game."

"Do you think she can recognize it? If not a single criminal can be found, then today will be a big shame."

The girl who looked very young at first glance made the people waiting for the test scratch their heads in wonder the moment she appeared.

I do remember that Officer Zhang told me in advance that he would play a good person.

One after another, they all looked at Li Wu with smiles on their faces.

But in that smile, upon closer inspection, there was also a hint of contempt.

No one thought that Li Wu, a young and gentle girl, could really successfully pick out their group of criminals with good acting skills from the crowd.

Li Wu was obviously aware of this weird friendly smile and didn't take it to heart. He only raised his eyes and looked at the heads of the group of people.

Looking at the red entries marked one after another with bold and enlarged red, the corners of his lips curled up silently.

"Let's get started."

Lu Yunzheng's cold voice sounded, breaking the silence in the air.

He raised his chin towards the crowd, signaling Li Wu to start distinguishing.

The surveillance camera in the corner of the office glowed red and meticulously relayed the footage of what happened to the leaders in the mysterious office.

in the office

Several leaders sat together and watched this scene with burning eyes.

Someone whispered: "She's going to start."

In the picture, Li Wu began to lift his legs and walk towards the crowd.

The criminals who were specially selected and looked like completely good guys on the surface always kept in mind what Officer Zhang said, to act well and act as a good guy.

A most kind smile appeared on Li Wu's face.

What fell in Li Wu's eyes was the conspicuous and direct entries one after another, marked in red and bold, above their heads.

[Burglary Murderer], [Impulsive Murderer], [Domestic Violence Murderer], [Bribery Murderer]...

One label after another comes into view.

Li Wu did not hesitate, raised his hand and quickly clicked in front of everyone:

"You, you, you, you, and you, all come out."

Everyone cooperates and goes out.

Li Wu turned to look at Lu Yunzheng, "It's them."

"They are all murderers."

The whole process took less than a minute, and the eight good criminals with kind faces carefully arranged by Officer Zhang were picked out one by one.

The smiles on the faces of the criminals who were singled out froze.
